hypotheses.persona: Hybrid office worker with strict morning fitness routine
hypotheses.rationale: Evidence remains consistent. Day 12 (Saturday) shows no morning fitness activity (plate at sink late afternoon), distinguishing weekend from weekday. The lack of laptop on Thu/Fri (Days 10-11) and presence on Wed (Day 9) strongly supports a hybrid schedule. Weekend departure (Day 6) for errands is distinct from work commute.

Still contradicted by consistent weekday morning departures (keys/phone at elsewhere) at 07:57-08:02, which are unlikely for a gym-only commute given the 05:00 start. The laptop presence on Day 9 is now interpreted as remote work day within a hybrid schedule, not evidence of full remote status.
Still contradicted by diurnal activity patterns. No evidence of sleeping during the day or night-shift specific object movements.

This reinforces the distinction between weekday (fitness + commute) and weekend (errands + leisure) routines.
